mode.title: Mode
mode.description: summary = one row per ticker with ownership percent, holders increased vs decreased, and the accumulation ratio. holders = one row per institution holding the stock. movers = only the institutions that actually changed their position, biggest buyers and biggest sellers.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: US tickers to look up, e.g. NVDA, TSLA, AAPL. Maximum 100 per run.

holdersPerSymbol.title: Holders per symbol (holders mode)
holdersPerSymbol.description: How many institutions to return for each ticker, taken from the top of the sort. Large caps have thousands of holders, so this is the main cost lever.

moversPerSide.title: Movers per side (movers mode)
moversPerSide.description: How many biggest buyers and how many biggest sellers to return per ticker. 10 returns up to 20 rows per ticker.

sortBy.title: Sort by (holders mode)
sortBy.description: Order institutions by position value, share change, or shares held.

minSharesChange.title: Min share change
minSharesChange.description: Skip institutions whose position moved by fewer shares than this, in either direction. 0 = keep every holder.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned across all tickers. Controls total cost.
